summary: Melee Survival 7/10/34 on two one-handed swords with a cat: Predator's Edge, Expose Prey into Mongoose Bite, Strider Kick and Lacerating Strikes. It ships as Forever's melee hunter build; a ranged Survival build plays like Marksmanship and is only documented.
rotation: Pre-pull: walk into melee at -6 s, Aspect of the Beast at -3 s
Racials, potions and other cooldowns on cooldown
Mongoose Bite whenever Expose Prey (or a dodge) opens it
Raptor Strike queued on the next swing when ready
Wing Clip in free GCDs (mana >= 50%), held when Mongoose Bite or Strider Kick is about ready
consumes: Dense Sharpening Stone (main hand and off hand)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 Agility and 14 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Pet scaling: 10% of RAP plus hunter hit (SoD placeholder for hit); on SoD's full 22% pet scaling this build would gain +18 (2026-10-12 gear)
Wildstalker Armor 4P/5P not in the preset (2P only); with them this build would gain 0 (measured on the 2026-10-12 gear)
Raptor Strike's level 32-56 flat bonuses look untuned (0.50-0.70 of Era); at 0.88 Survival would gain about +1.2%
Human is best only through its sword racial; without weapon racials Orc and Night Elf tie (852.0 / 851.8)
Fire-toasted Bun (+9) left out as a seasonal item; Elemental Sharpening Stone left out (MC-only plans)
notes: Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_sv) unchanged; it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Distance is 5 yd as in the mksettings raid the number was measured in (the UI preset starts at 25 yd; the APL walks in 6 s before the pull, which the preset says costs nothing). Survival keeps a 1.0 sec cat out (DefaultOptions).
